description: Caribbean Netherlands; Aviation, monthly airport data is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. This table describes the number of aircraft movements and the number of passenger arrivals and passenger departures at the airports of Bonaire, St Eustatius and Saba. These Caribbean islands have been part of the Netherlands as special municipalities as of 10 October, 2010. Airports Caribbean Netherlands - Bonaire: Flamingo Airport - St Eustatius: F.D. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
